lead.question: 蜘蛛令人厌恶，作者却称它们是朋友，一年中它们有多少时间在消灭昆虫？
lead.warmup: 提起蜘蛛，许多人第一反应是厌恶甚至害怕，恨不得立刻拍死。但这篇选自《听众》的文章却大声呼吁：别伤害蜘蛛。作者用一组惊人的数据说明，蜘蛛一年中至少有一半时间在消灭昆虫，功劳远超鸟类和野兽；它们不是昆虫，从不伤害我们与我们财物。读完你就会明白，这个不起眼的小生物，其实是庄稼与牛羊的守护者。
goals: 掌握 spider, insect, devour, estimate, acre, census 等本课核心词汇。
理解并会分析 why, you may wonder 这类插入语及疑问句结构。
学会用现在完成时与被动语态客观陈述调查、估计等事实。
能用比较级表达蜘蛛与其他食虫动物在灭虫数量上的差异。
lead.summary: 本文选自《听众》杂志。作者指出蜘蛛是我们的朋友：它们消灭大量昆虫，而昆虫是人类的大敌。与鸟兽相比，蜘蛛消灭的昆虫多得多，且从不伤害我们和我们的财物。蜘蛛不是昆虫，它有八条腿，昆虫至多六条。一位蜘蛛权威调查发现，每英亩草地竟有二百多万只蜘蛛，它们一年至少半年忙于灭虫，所消灭昆虫的总重量超过全英国人的体重。
lead.tips: why, you may wonder 是插入语，去掉后句子结构才清楚：You may wonder why spiders should be our friends? 写作时插入语两侧要用逗号隔开，切勿与主句混为一谈。

questions.q: How much of each year do spiders spend killing insects?
questions.zh: 蜘蛛一年中有多少时间在消灭昆虫？
questions.hint: 见课文 Spiders are busy for at least half the year in killing insects.

questions.q: Why should spiders be our friends?
questions.zh: 为什么蜘蛛应当是我们的朋友？
questions.a: Because they destroy so many insects, and insects include some of the greatest enemies of the human race.
questions.aZh: 因为它们消灭那么多昆虫，而昆虫中包括一些人类最大的敌人。
questions.hint: 见课文开头 Because they destroy so many insects…

questions.q: How can one tell a spider from an insect?
questions.zh: 怎样一眼看出蜘蛛和昆虫的差别？
questions.a: A spider always has eight legs and an insect never more than six.
questions.aZh: 蜘蛛总是有八条腿，而昆虫的腿从不超过六条。
questions.hint: 见课文 One can tell the difference almost at a glance…

questions.q: What did the authority on spiders estimate in the south of England?
questions.zh: 那位蜘蛛研究权威在英国南部估计出了什么？
questions.a: He estimated that there were more than 2,250,000 spiders in one acre, that is about 6,000,000 of different kinds on a football pitch.
questions.aZh: 他估计每英亩有225万多只蜘蛛，也就是说一个足球场上约有600万只不同种类的蜘蛛。
questions.hint: 见课文 made a census… and he estimated that…

questions.q: Why does the author say the insects destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year would weigh more than all the people in the country?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说英国蜘蛛一年消灭的昆虫重量超过全国人口的总重量？
questions.a: To show how enormous the spiders' work is, so that we should spare them instead of killing them.
questions.aZh: 为了说明蜘蛛灭虫的功劳之大，我们应当保护它们而不是伤害它们。
questions.hint: 结合作者写作目的与课文结尾的估计数据思考。

exercises.q: 汉译英：昆虫会吞食我们全部的庄稼，杀死我们成群的牛羊。
exercises.a: Insects would devour all our crops and kill our flocks and herds.
exercises.note: devour 指狼吞虎咽地吞食。

exercises.q: 汉译英：要不是有食虫动物的保护，昆虫就会使我们无法在地球上生活下去。
exercises.a: If it were not for the protection we get from insect-eating animals, insects would make it impossible for us to live in the world.
exercises.note: if it were not for 为虚拟语气。

exercises.q: 句型转换：They have destroyed a large number of insects.（改为被动语态）
exercises.a: A large number of insects have been destroyed by them.
exercises.note: 现在完成时的被动为 have been done。

exercises.q: 填空：One authority on spiders made a ____ of them and ____ that there were more than 2,250,000 in one ____.
改错：Spiders are not insects, nor even nearly related with them.
exercises.a: related to them（related to 为固定搭配，不用 with）
exercises.note: be related to 表示与……有关。

exercises.q: 汉译英：与鸟兽相比，蜘蛛消灭的昆虫要多得多。
exercises.a: Spiders destroy far more insects than birds and beasts do.
exercises.note: 比较级 far more…than 差异明显。

exercises.q: 填空：It ____ been estimated that the weight of all the insects destroyed by spiders in Britain in one year ____ be greater than that of all the human beings.
exercises.note: It has been estimated 意为据估计。

quiz.q: 蜘蛛一年中至少有多长时间在消灭昆虫？
quiz.note: at least half the year 至少半年。

quiz.q: 蜘蛛与昆虫最关键的区别是什么？
options: A spider has eight legs while an insect has no more than six.
Spiders have wings but insects do not.
Spiders live only in grass fields.

quiz.q: 作者认为哪一类动物消灭的昆虫最多？
一位权威对英国南部草地蜘蛛数量的估计是？
options: Fewer than 1,000 on a football pitch.

quiz.q: 文中 devour 的意思最接近？
作者写这篇文章的主要目的是什么？
options: To teach readers how to keep spiders as pets.
To persuade us not to harm spiders.
To explain how a census is done.
To compare British and foreign spiders.
